sources.label: Pokémon GO related and other patches for apps I use.
sources.author: DanielTheManiel
patch_list: Keeps chats updating live: reconnects the real-time message connection when it drops (e.g. after the app was in the background) and restores the chat's subscriptions.
Adds a filter button on the map to only show posts from the past 24 hours, 12 hours, hour or 10 minutes.
Uses Android 12+ wallpaper-derived Material You colors throughout Campfire, with a dark theme that follows the system. Keeps success/warning/danger and game-brand colors.

Routes Google Play Services to MicroG-RE (app.revanced.android.gms) so Google sign-in and push notifications work on the re-signed app. Install MicroG-RE, add your account there and enable Cloud Messaging.
Opens Pokémon GO (and other game) links straight in the game instead of going through the AppsFlyer OneLink redirect page.
Opens external links right away instead of asking for confirmation first.
